Class BankAccountTriggerHelper

public inherited sharing class BankAccountTriggerHelper

Helper for BankAccountTriggerHandler. Encapsulates the trigger business logic for BankAccount__c: flagging pending registration updates on ACH recipients, promoting a record to default in the after-context, and cascade-deleting Link junction children when their parent bank account is deleted.

private static final String ACH_RECORD_TYPE

DeveloperName of the ACH-recipient record type on BankAccount__c. Used to limit registration-update tracking to ACH bank accounts.

CodeSettings__mdt category key whose comma-delimited value lists the BankAccount__c fields tracked by checkModifiedFields for pending registration updates.

Status__c picklist value representing an active bank account. Used to gate checkModifiedFields so only active records are evaluated for pending updates.

DeveloperName of the junction-link record type on BankAccount__c. Used to identify and process records that link a parent bank account to additional venues.

Methods

public static void cascadeDeleteAccountLinks(BankAccountTriggerHandler handler)

Cascade-deletes any junction-link BankAccount__c records that point at a parent bank account being deleted in the current trigger context. Records of the link record type that are themselves being deleted are skipped (no recursive cascade), and records already in Trigger.oldMap are excluded to avoid DML conflicts in mixed bulk-deletes. Compensates for the platform constraint that self-lookups cannot use a Cascade delete option.

Parameters:
    handler – BankAccountTriggerHandler (reserved for parity with sibling helper methods; not currently consumed)

Since:
    05/08/2026

public static void checkModifiedFields(BankAccountTriggerHandler handler)

Inspects bank-account records being saved and flags those whose configured registration fields have changed by setting PendingBankUpdate__c and composing a Message__c describing the changes. Logic runs only for active ACH records that do not have IgnoreChanges__c set; records with IgnoreChanges__c are reset.

Parameters:
    handler – BankAccountTriggerHandler providing trigger context utilities such as isUpdated

public static void runAfterLogic(BankAccountTriggerHandler handler)

Runs after-context logic on a single bank-account record. Promotes the record to default (via BankAccountService.makeDefault) when the venue has a single bank account or when IsDefault__c becomes true.

Parameters:
    handler – BankAccountTriggerHandler providing trigger context utilities such as isNewOrUpdated

public static void setLinkAccountNames(BankAccountTriggerHandler handler)

Copies the parent bank account's Name onto each Link record being inserted, so a junction-link row carries the same display name as the bank account it points at. Only Link record-type rows with a populated ParentBankAccount__c are touched; other record types are left untouched.

Parameters:
    handler – BankAccountTriggerHandler (reserved for parity with sibling helper methods; not currently consumed)

Since:
    05/09/2026
